# Native v1 compatibility fixture

`vector-v1.pcraft` is a STORE ZIP with `manifest.json` only; `vector-v1.json` is its readable mirror. Original Local Image fixture, GPL-3.0-or-later. Generated by `crates/pc-format/examples/vector_arch_fixture.rs` on 2026-10-10 using the existing version-1 schema; the additive fields are empty and omitted. It contains a live rectangle with fill/stroke, a vector mask, point text, a saved path, a work path and a clipping path. No new content variant, external blob, font or renderer is needed to load it. The JSON explicitly has no `vector`, `symbols` or `design_units` keys. Both files are under 50 KB.

Tests load the checked-in bytes, not a document generated by the implementation under test. Do not regenerate this fixture when changing the schema; add another versioned fixture instead. The generator is retained to explain its provenance. V8 must also test the version-1 reader's `TooNew` path using a version-2 manifest with symbol instances.
